We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a blasting worker (爆破员) Wu, with safety officer Yang, took explosives and detonated, violating regulations (cannot independently conduct blasting). The blast caused flying stones that hit a villager Yang Jia's head, causing death. So causing death due to negligence? Likely "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "非法使用爆炸物罪"? Chinese criminal law: Using explosives illegally causing death could be "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、使用爆炸物罪" (illegal use of explosives) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". Also "过失致人死亡罪". The facts: He violated safety regulations, unauthorized blasting, causing death. The appropriate charge: "过失致人死亡罪" (negligent homicide). Also possibly "非法使用爆炸物罪". Which is more appropriate? The law: Article 122 of Criminal Law: "违反安全管理规定，造成重大事故，致人死亡的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑". That's "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". Actually Article 119: "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" includes using explosives causing death. Also Article 133: "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、使用爆炸物罪". The facts: He used explosives without proper qualification, causing death. Likely charge: "非法使用爆炸物罪". But also "过失致人死亡罪" is for negligence not using dangerous method. Since he used explosives, it's dangerous method. So "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". The examples earlier: For illegal acquisition of personal info they gave "非法获取公民个人信息". For bribery they gave "行贿". For destroying computer info they gave "破坏计算机信息系统". So they use concise Chinese crime names. So we need to output appropriate crime name.

Thus answer: [罪名]以危险方法危害公共安全罪<eoa>

Check if also "非法使用爆炸物罪". Which is more precise? The fact says he had blasting certificate but not allowed to independently do blasting. So he illegally used explosives. That matches "非法使用爆炸物罪". The law: Article 133: "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、使用爆炸物罪" includes using without permission. So likely that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法使用爆炸物罪<eoa>

We can include both? Usually one charge. I'd choose "非法使用爆炸物罪".
